Text: WHEN the loyalty service posts points for a purchase, the customer mobile app shall display the updated points balance on the member's next balance request.
Rationale: Members check the app right after paying; a stale balance drives support tickets (S-03).

Text: IF the fraud engine places a hold on a purchase, THEN the loyalty service shall keep the points of that purchase in pending state until the fraud engine releases the hold.
Rationale: Prevents fraudulent points from being redeemed before review.

Text: WHEN the loyalty service posts points for a purchase, the loyalty service shall send a push notification to the member with the points earned.
Rationale: Withdrawn by SH-01 on 2026-11-03; the notification channel is decided later.

Text: As a member, I want to spend 500 of my posted points as an SGD 5 voucher at the till, so that my points reduce what I pay.
Rationale: First end-to-end slice of epic LOY-210 (workflow steps, one fixed voucher value); must-have for launch per SH-01.

Text: As a support agent, I want to cancel a member's unused voucher, so that the member gets the points back without a manual points adjustment.
Rationale: Workflow step split from epic LOY-210 so support can resolve voucher complaints; SH-01 rated it should.

Text: WHEN the POS sends a voucher validation request at the planned peak load, the loyalty service shall return the validation result within TBD ms for 95% of requests.
Rationale: "Checkout must not get slower" (SH-02); voucher validation is a new call in the checkout path; target is open question Q1.

Text: The loyalty service shall accept TBD purchase events per minute for TBD minutes without losing an event.
Rationale: "Must survive the year-end sale peak" (SH-08); last year's peak was 9,000 purchases per minute; planned peak is open question Q3.

Text: The loyalty service shall reject API requests from the POS and the customer mobile app that do not carry valid client credentials.
Rationale: "Every call from the tills and the app must be authenticated" (SH-05).

Text: The loyalty service shall exchange purchase events and voucher validation calls with the POS as defined in the TillPoint POS loyalty interface spec v2.1.
Rationale: The POS vendor does not change the interface before TillPoint v2.2 (SH-08).

Text: The loyalty service shall store member personal data only in data centers located in Singapore.
Rationale: The data protection officer requires member personal data to stay in Singapore under DRP-2024.

Text: The loyalty service shall run on the shared Kubernetes platform.
Rationale: Platform team standard for every new service; no exceptions in 2026 (SH-08).
